content:
Decisions from the user on 2026-09-30.

1. Scope. English and German are the two prose languages. Every further language is an add-on package. German gets the same prose slop gate that English has today.
2. Punctuation. German follows Duden typography. A density rule blocks when the Gedankenstrich count passes a threshold. The threshold comes from measurement, because the Duden gives no number.
3. Surfaces. Prose files and commit messages get German rules. Code comments keep the English rules.
4. Measurement. The user proposes a German Wikipedia dump from before 2018 as the human corpus. archive.org holds dewiki-20180920-pages-articles.xml.bz2 at 4.96 GB. ADW measures and does not train a model.
5. Duden online. The user wants live lookups, because every harness runs online. A local fallback covers an outage. Feasibility depends on the duden.de terms of use.
6. Detection. Automatic per text unit, German or English. The method is still open.
title: T-001 grilling round 1 decisions
